**Pull request #1591 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #1591: Patch: the co-op result panel says when the daily Jlore cap held a seat's pay back

Closes #1567

A capped co-op seat now sees "Daily Jlore reached" on the co-op result panel, carried per-seat on the duos `view` frame exactly as the 1v1 frame carries it.

What changed and why: `pay_coop` already paid co-op seats against the same daily cap but discarded the capped flag, so a capped player earned less with no explanation. The flag now travels end to end: `duos_game_jlore_caps` reads it off the ledger plus the recorded result (below-rate `game` row for the match and day at `JLORE_GAMES_DAILY_CAP`), the actor stores it per seat and sends each socket only its own, and `DuosBoard` renders the existing line. Server: `crates/server/src/duos/protocol.rs` (`jlore_capped` on `View`, skipped while false), `crates/server/src/duos/mod.rs` (new `duos_game_jlore_caps`), `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs` (`Core.jlore_capped`, per-seat `push_view`, `load_jlore_caps`, calls in `on_terminal` with announce and in `on_arm` for rebuilt actors). Web: `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts` (frame, parse, snapshot, handle), `DuosBoard.tsx` (required `jloreCapped` prop, `ResultPanel` line), `DuosRoute.tsx` passes it through, dev and replay routes pass `false`, new `duos-result-jlore` testids in both testid files. Spec: R1483000 widens to co-op with 3 new proofs, R1502000 drops the stale "frames do not yet say it" sentence, index regenerated. No new ruling; action log, replays, Download JSON untouched.

How tested (all observed this session): new `r1483000_a_capped_coop_seat_sees_it_on_its_own_view_and_after_a_rebuild` plus full `actor::duos::` suite — 43 passed; `socket.test.ts` 23 passed; `DuosBoard.test.tsx` 44 passed; `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, eslint on all touched files, `cargo jackioh spec check` (1064 rulings ok), catalog and patches checks — all green.

Decisions the issue did not settle: R1502000's Rejected paragraph lost its "jloreCapped on co-op frames left for a follow-up" line since this is that follow-up (alternative: leave it, rejected as stale text contradicting the change); the server test asserts flag vectors with `all(...)` rather than exact single-element vectors because attach and hello each push a view (alternative: exact match, rejected as timing-fragile); `end_as_ceiling_draw` does not load caps, matching the 1v1's panicked-ceiling path which also skips it. Reviewers should look twice at `duos_game_jlore_caps`'s void/unreadable-result early returns and at `load_jlore_caps(false)` running before `on_terminal()`'s early return on the rebuilt-actor path — the flags land via later attaches, not an announce.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 37.7 min | green | approve |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 8s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 501s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 4s |

</details>
```
